target: Site Health private portfolio home and project directory

contract.purpose: Site Health gives the owner one private evidence-backed view of portfolio state, domains, performance, Google Search, and AI awareness.
contract.purposeSource: canonical Site Health catalog and landing-page purpose audit
contract.canonicalPurpose: One private owner view for deciding what exists, what works, and what deserves attention across the Fleet portfolio.
contract.audience: The Fleet owner operating and prioritizing the portfolio.
contract.job: Find the state of a project or metric and decide where attention belongs, even when a collector is temporarily unavailable.
contract.thesis: Lead with the five owner decisions, then expose evidence and missing evidence without pretending the local backend is online.
contract.system: Dense dark owner console with restrained mint emphasis, strong editorial hierarchy, and explicit operational states.
contract.signature: The five-question decision map makes the product model visible before the project directory.
contract.risk: A data-heavy dashboard can look like a generic admin panel or become meaningless when its backend is offline.

findings: The local static preview intentionally shows two backend-unavailable states; their copy remains truthful and the product purpose still reads without live data.
Site Health is intentionally private and noindex, so public SEO and GEO qualification are not applicable.

comprehension.reviewer: independent purpose audit plus current responsive visual inspection

answers.product: A private evidence dashboard for the Fleet portfolio.
answers.value: It replaces scattered dashboards with one decision view.
answers.mechanism: Five areas connect project state, domains, repeated performance evidence, search, and AI awareness.
answers.proof: The current surface exposes the five decision areas, live refresh controls, filters, evidence states, and honest unavailable states.
answers.nextAction: Refresh the portfolio or choose a decision area/project.

ownerFeedback.note: Owner delegated portfolio landing quality and asked for priority-scaled execution without repeated review pauses.
